card.name: Inside intrathecal and intravenous route words
card.fires_on: The last piece of the route words intrathecal and intravenous, as in intrathe-cal, intrathec-ally and intr-aven-ously, in warnings about route of administration.

modes.label: Intrathecal
modes.description: The ending of intrathecal after 'intrathe' or 'intrathec' in statements about use not being established or approved.
modes.example: The safety and effectiveness of ProHance have not been established with intrathe<<cal>> use.

modes.label: Intravenous
modes.description: The middle of intravenously after 'intr' in dosing instructions for dexamethasone.
modes.example: dexamethasone 20 mg (or equivalent) orally or intr<<aven>>ously prior to every DARZALEX
